# Qasara

Canton Network infrastructure. Cove is a non-custodial wallet API; some of its
endpoints are payable per call in Canton Coin, with no signup.

## Agent API — no signup, no API key, pay in CC

Discovery:   GET  https://walletapi.cove.qasara.ai/v1/x402/info          (free)
Ping:        GET  https://walletapi.cove.qasara.ai/v1/x402/ping          (0.01 CC)
Fee schedule: POST https://walletapi.cove.qasara.ai/v1/x402/transfers/fee-preview  (0.02 CC)

Flow:
1. Call a priced endpoint without payment → 402 response with a
   PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 JSON: amount, payTo, feePayer,
   assetTransferMethod, synchronizerId, instrumentId).
2. Pay the exact CC amount on Canton mainnet: sign a TransferFactory_Transfer
   naming the merchant as receiver (transfer-factory) — you do not submit it;
   the facilitator relays it and pays the traffic, settling in one transaction.
3. Retry the same request with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.
4. Get the response, with a PAYMENT-RESPONSE header confirming settlement.

Call GET /v1/x402/info first to see every route and its price in CC before
sending a payment. Prices are quoted in atomic units: 1 CC = 10^10.

Merchant party (payTo):
  qasara-validator-1::1220632cdae7977b01e0024d6310a32003bb67a6215cbdfffc6bbc8791be2382f0e0
Network: canton:mainnet   Instrument: Amulet
Facilitator: https://facilitator.ftptech.xyz

Your payer party must be hosted by the facilitator, because its relay reads
your holdings from its own participant. The merchant party need not be:
preapproval lookup is Scan-backed, so hosting does not matter on that side.

What the priced endpoints return:
- /v1/x402/ping — a timestamp, the paying party, and the settling update id.
  Touches no data; it exists to prove the payment loop end to end.
- /v1/x402/transfers/fee-preview — the live Amulet fee schedule for a CC or
  CIP-56 transfer, plus the current traffic price, CC price and mining round.
  Pass amountCc and outputCount to get the Amulet fee subtotal for your
  transfer. It returns no total cost: the Canton traffic term is set by the
  sequencer against a free base-rate allowance and cannot be derived from a
  payload size, so it is reported absent (trafficCost.included: false) rather
  than estimated. Machine-readable caveats come back in flags[].code.

Errors:
- 402 — payment required, or the facilitator rejected the payment. The body and
  the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header carry the reason.
- 400 — the payment envelope was malformed or the facilitator refused it.
  Retrying it unchanged will not help.
- 502 — the facilitator is unreachable. Retry with the same payment; do not pay
  again.

## Developer API — API key, non-custodial

https://walletapi.cove.qasara.ai/v1

Cove Wallet API: a REST gateway to Canton for parties that hold their own keys.
Prepare-sign-broadcast, so Cove never holds a private key. Covers party
allocation, balances, CC and CIP-56 transfers, DvP settlement, regulated-asset
issuance and redemption, and real-time event streams over WebSocket and SSE.

Requires an API key. Contact https://qasara.ai/contact
